reserve_gas.nominal_composition: dry breathable air stored preblended and purity-verified; actual bank composition must be tested before refill
reserve_recharge_sources: refill from compatible service plant with source purity and mass verified

distribution.conditional_use: Only permitted when local valves, gas purity, receiving-zone pressure, leak limits and thermal control all satisfy operational safeguards
distribution.route_policy: A path in a service graph conveys possible plumbing only. Normally closed isolation points must be operated in a safe sequence and mechanically verified.
distribution.overpressure_policy: Pressure ramp limit and nominal target pressure must be enforced; bulk refill not allowed until containment proven
distribution.accessibility: A remote bank in an unoccupied tank bay may require suited/isolated work; opening a bank valve does not grant crew access.

rulebook: Atmospheric air within the ship's pressurised spaces is physical initial inventory; never treat it as the 5.5 t compressed reserve twice.
Normal metabolic oxygen generation and regenerable CO2 scrubbing do not restore inert-buffer pressure lost in a breach.
One full arc refill is budgeted; two complete arcs cannot both be fully restored from the 5.5 t nominal reserve alone.
No invisible atmosphere or simulated crew breathability for the 83 unclassified industrial/cargo spaces.
Local gas rescue and pressure equalisation require safe receiving containment, route valves and time; neither a schematic nor a work receipt is proof of repair.
